# Maintaining dotnet-ai-toolkit

Follow root `AGENTS.md`. This is a Node.js-assisted content toolkit for .NET development, not a C# application. Consumer project structures live in `templates/` and shared guidance in `knowledge/`; do not scaffold runtime services here.

Use canonical `skills/` and `agents/` sources. Host instructions live in `.claude/`, `.codex/`, `.cursor/`, `.opencode/`, and `.github/`. Installed native files are generated by `scripts/install.mjs` in a separate repository. Keep scripts dependency-free, ESM, and compatible with the Node.js range in `package.json`.

Run focused tests after edits and `npm run check` before handoff. Preserve no-overwrite and read-only role guarantees. Keep instructions evidence-driven, .NET-specific, original, and free of sensitive payloads.

## Maintenance Matrix

| Changed source | Update/check |
| --- | --- |
| `skills/` | `toolkit.json`, `evals/discovery.json`, README, changelog, metadata tests |
| `agents/` or catalog descriptions | Installer-rendered metadata and host installation tests |
| Host folders or installer | `docs/adoption.md`, README, temporary-directory safety tests |
| `templates/` or `knowledge/` | Neighboring workflows, architecture/verification guidance, local links |
| Root folder layout | Structure regression, catalog kinds, installer destinations |
| MCP examples | Integration guide, JSON validation, approval boundary |
| Version | `package.json`, `toolkit.json`, changelog |
| CI/toolchain | CI/setup workflows, release event/permission boundaries, supported Node.js range, test commands |
| `website/` or documentation deployment | `docs/website.md`, canonical content generation, `npm run docs:build`, `npm run docs:check`, Pages permissions |
| Skills archive packaging | `docs/adoption.md`, canonical source preservation, bundled resource paths, archive limits, temporary-target Vercel CLI checks |
